title: Skyttels: Save & Restart crash
problem: The community says that after Skyttels copies enchanted gems, "Save & Restart" crashes the game when it restarts (the save itself completes). No static path from Skyttels to the save data exists in the code read: the copies are battle objects the game deletes when the battle is cleaned up, and Save & Restart is an overworld menu action, so the copies should be gone when the game saves.
notes: Text: At the start of battle, this creature gains copies of your other creatures' permanent Spell Gems. This trait does not work on creatures that also have this trait. Evidence: Copies: inv_CreateSpellGem -> instance_create obj_spellgem (object 0x3c7); obj_spellgem Create sets inbattle = (room == battle room) @0x147647cde / 0x147647d7d. bc_CleanUpBattle: with (obj_spellgem) { magnification = 0; cantripology = 0; free = 0; if (inbattle) scr_RemoveInstance(id) } @0x1406881a0-0x14068836e. extragems is read by no save_* function (refs only in battle code and scr_UpdateCreature). Save & Restart (L_MENU_SAVE_RESTART, object event @0x147105d17 / 0x1471dbab2): confirm path calls scr_OverworldMsgStackAdd and scr_SaveGame @0x1471dbfb6 (overworld only). The copy loop copies elements (no shared array). Test: 1) Party: Skyttels holder + an ally whose permanent gem has an Enchanter class-swap enchantment. Win a battle, return to the overworld, use Save & Restart. 2) Same party, ally gems unenchanted (control). 3) Same as 1 without the Skyttels holder (control for the enchantment alone). Outcomes: crash only in 1 -> a Skyttels leak exists that static reading missed (next: trace scr_SaveGame / spell-gem load using the save from run 1); crash in 1 and 3 -> the enchantment, not Skyttels, crashes Save & Restart; no crash anywhere -> not reproducible on 2.0.38, close it. Reasoning: Every static route was checked: creation, battle cleanup (removes all battle-created gems), the save trigger (overworld only) and the copy loop. None carries the copies into the save, so a crash at restart can only be confirmed or ruled out in game. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26).
